spec.expr:
label_join(
  (
  label_replace(
    label_replace(((rate(ubntStaRxBytes{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8) / 1e6) and on (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) (round((ubntStaRxCapacity{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"} * 1000) / 1e6, 0.01) > 0),
      "reading", "Throughput", "instance", ".+")
    or label_replace((round((ubntStaRxCapacity{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"} * 1000) / 1e6, 0.01) > 0) and on (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) ((rate(ubntStaRxBytes{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8) / 1e6),
      "reading", "Capacity", "instance", ".+"),
    "direction", "RX", "instance", ".+")
  or   label_replace(
    label_replace(((rate(ubntStaTxBytes{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8) / 1e6) and on (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) (round((ubntStaTxCapacity{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"} * 1000) / 1e6, 0.01) > 0),
      "reading", "Throughput", "instance", ".+")
    or label_replace((round((ubntStaTxCapacity{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"} * 1000) / 1e6, 0.01) > 0) and on (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) ((rate(ubntStaTxBytes{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8) / 1e6),
      "reading", "Capacity", "instance", ".+"),
    "direction", "TX", "instance", ".+")
  ) * on (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) group_left (peer_suffix) (
    label_join((group by (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) (ubntStaMac{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"})) and on (instance) (count by (instance) (group by (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) (ubntStaMac{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"})) > 1),
      "peer_suffix", " · ", "unused", "ubntStaMac", "ubntWlStatIndex")
    or on (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) (group by (instance, ubntWlStatIndex, ubntStaMac) (ubntStaMac{job="ubiquiti_snmp",instance="$instance"}))
  ),
  "peer", "", "direction", "peer_suffix")
